title: Julia Cameron
hero_prompt: Wide 12:5 darkened backdrop. A single writing desk at an angle, a hand moving across three pages of open notebooks in longhand, the pen caught mid-stroke — pages fan out left to right suggesting momentum and sequence. Dense cross-hatching shadows the background; the lit desk surface is the only relief. Woodblock-print texture throughout, bold ink lines, no photographic smoothness. The spirit is disciplined daily recurrence: the same desk, the same hand, the same three pages, every morning. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem: three stacked horizontal rectangles (suggesting three pages of morning pages) with a single diagonal pen-stroke crossing all three from bottom-left to top-right. Black on off-white. Hard woodcut edges — no fine linework, no gradients. Survives at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels.
